reason: I already run small store trials off POS reports and can never prove what caused the lift, so a matched-control test with a full refund if it fails is worth PHP 75,000 to me. That is small enough that I can sign it off without a long fight with the owner.
objection: Our CCTV is old and low resolution, and you're a brand-new company with no results. I'm only signing if the free camera check actually passes in the stores I'd pick, and I want to see who decides whether the test 'beat' control before we start.
would_change_my_mind: If the camera-readiness check says our cameras aren't good enough, or the refund terms leave the win/loss call to StoreLab, I walk away.
